shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git log --stat | head -50 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

for f in src/* index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls node_modules | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>&1; npm view @gravity-ui/uikit version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -20
npm view @gravity-ui/uikit peerDependenciesMeta time.modified dist-tags 2>&1 | head -30 && npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -15

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat package.json | head -60; ls; ls styles 2>/dev/null; sed -n 1,120p README.md; ls ../; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm audit 2>&1 | head -40
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm | head; cat build/esm/index.d.ts | head -80; ls build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls controls theme Button Checkbox layout; cat controls/index.d.ts theme/index.d.ts layout/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null
cat theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts theme/Provider.d.ts theme/types.d.ts; cat controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts controls/types.d.ts
cat Button/Button.d.ts Button/types.d.ts Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; ls Card Text; cat Card/Card.d.ts Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n "ControlProps\b" -A25 build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -40; cat build/esm/components/Button/constants.d.ts; head -c 600 styles/fonts.css; echo; head -c 400 styles/styles.css; echo; grep -o 'url([^)]*)' styles/*.css | head; cat build/esm/components/theme/Provider.js | head -40

cat build/esm/components/theme/LangProvider.d.ts; grep -n "Lang\b\|Ru\|En" build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts | head; ls build/esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/; ls build/esm/components/controls/PasswordInput/i18n 2>/dev/null

grep -n "variant" -A3 build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "TEXT_VARIANTS\|header-1\|subheader" -r build/esm/components/Text/text/*.d.ts | head; grep -n "spacing\|gap" build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && sed -n 1,25p layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts; grep -n "Space\b\|type Space\|spacing-" layout/types.d.ts | head; grep -n "padding\|spacing" layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head
grep -n "^\s*\(gap\|padding\w*\|maxWidth\|width\)?:" layout/types.d.ts layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head -20

grep -c "color-base-generic:" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css; echo "dist/" >> .gitignore; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npx --no-install playwright --version 2>&1 | head -1
mkdir -p /tmp/pw && cd /tmp/pw && npm init -y >/dev/null && npm i playwright@1 >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -2

for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do grep -qa "vite preview" $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null && kill ${p#/proc/}; done; cat > /tmp/pwscripts/vite.ssr.config.mjs <<'EOF'
export default { ssr: { noExternal: [/@gravity-ui/] } };
EOF
npx vite-node --root /home/sandbox/workspace --config /tmp/pwscripts/vite.ssr.config.mjs /tmp/pwscripts/ssr.tsx 2>&1 | tail -15
npx vite-node --root /home/sandbox/workspace --config /tmp/pwscripts/vite.ssr.config.mjs /tmp/pwscripts/ssr.tsx 2>&1 | tail -15; ps aux 2>/dev/null | grep -c "[v]ite preview"
npx vite-node --root /home/sandbox/workspace --config /tmp/pwscripts/vite.ssr.config.mjs /tmp/pwscripts/ssr.tsx 2>&1 | grep -iv "^\s*at " | head -15

echo "export default { ssr: { noExternal: [/@gravity-ui/] } };" > /tmp/pwscripts/vite.ssr.config.mjs && npx vite-node --root /home/sandbox/workspace --config /tmp/pwscripts/vite.ssr.config.mjs /tmp/pwscripts/ssr.tsx 2>&1 | grep -v "^\s*at " | tail -15

sed -i '1i import React from "react";' /tmp/pwscripts/ssr.tsx && npx vite-node --root /home/sandbox/workspace --config /tmp/pwscripts/vite.ssr.config.mjs /tmp/pwscripts/ssr.tsx 2>&1 | grep -v "^\s*at " | tail -15

sed -i 's/for (const s of/console.log(html.match(\/<input[^>]*>\/g)?.join("\\n"));\nfor (const s of/' /tmp/pwscripts/ssr.tsx && npx vite-node --root /home/sandbox/workspace --config /tmp/pwscripts/vite.ssr.config.mjs /tmp/pwscripts/ssr.tsx 2>&1 | head -4
rm -rf /tmp/pwscripts dist && git status --short && git diff --stat
